name: Candy Sweet
source: I've known Candy since high school. Back then, her surname was Clarrens, and she was shy and reserved girl. Over the years since graduation, something changed for the better in her. She completely changed her image and surname, transforming into the beauty Candy Sweet, becoming a famous blogger and one of the leading models in the series of pin-up cards collected by Elijah.
